scope: Report-only operational anchor terminal policy and five literal public-log allowlist additions. No actual model, API, service, database, Git, data sync or publication action by reviewer.

checks.original_strict_facts_preserved: All-four-anchor strict success is retained as a factual strict_only check; false/failed actual labels and rejection counts are not rewritten or counted as correct forecasts.
checks.operational_terminal_evidence: Exactly four distinct current-input anchor scenarios each require final complete-path compatibility. Accepted outputs require a real result/error-free terminal and general exact successful independent review. Rejected outputs require null/no result, a real error, complete two-response audit and genuine two-validation-failure terminal with current final raw rejected; the one-call exception needs the existing strictly verified complete-fact budget/path proof.
checks.independent_rejection_binding: Rejected-anchor case set and per-case exact record SHA must match verified current independent rejection review. Missing/incomplete/unverified/wrong hashes/cases/path/current-input count remain blockers.
checks.no_diagnostic_availability_quota: Zero successful anchor outputs can be terminally audited operationally without silently becoming four correct predictions. This matches explicit post-two-failure error behavior rather than imposing diagnostic-subset100% success.
checks.production_hard_requirements: Successful fresh real production manual brief/detail/English/current-live, exact independent source review, known accepted-P2 closure, error UI, preservation/source deployment and public scan remain mandatory; valid diagnostic rejection does not waive production failure.
checks.public_log_allowlist: The sync diff only adds five literal test/verification log names. File selection, public-safe sanitization, archive/env/DB exclusions, source/public SHA manifest generation and copy logic remain byte-identical otherwise.

operational_new_methods.coverage: 13 terminal/review/path/counterfeit negative subcases, all-rejected/no-quota, budget positive/negative and production/P2/known-error blockers

sync_self_tests.mode: Synthetic temporary-file tests only; actual publication synchronization not run

boundary: Policy/data audit only. This does not establish real production success, give unsupported operational label exemptions, count rejected model outputs as accurate, or rewrite any prior actual/prediction/acceptance baseline.
